subject: Corridor and Neighborhood Commercial Node Rezoning
overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee discussed proposed zoning ordinance updates with consultants from Innes Associates, focusing on commercial corridors, neighborhood commercial nodes, and accessory commercial units. After discussing maps, height limits, parking requirements, and public feedback, the committee voted to keep the matter in committee.

items.title: Paper 24033 - Zoning Ordinance Updates
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed rezoning plans for city corridors and neighborhood commercial nodes, including a new 'accessory commercial unit' concept, and voted to keep the paper in committee.
